sanskrit: papraccha bhairavī devī śayanīye sukhoṣitātena mantreṇa deveśa ! siddhau tau vada me prabho !ugratārā - mahāmantraṃ pañcārṇaṃ parijapya cavaśiṣṭhopyena mārādhya nakṣatralokamāgataḥtaduddhāramataṃ vakṣye yataḥ sarveśvaro bhavetkūrcamastraṃ mantrarājo devadruma ivāparaḥdurvvāsāḥ - vyāsa - vālmīki - bhāradvājādikaḥ kaviḥiti te kathitaṃ devi ! rahasyaṃ paramottamamgopanīyaṃ prayatnena yadi sneho'sti māṃ pratibauddhadevena yaccīrṇaṃ prātaḥ kṛtyaṃ vadasva meuttaraprahare mantrī sahasradalapaṅkajeśuddhasphaṭikasaṅkāśaṃ śuddhakṣaumavirājitamgandhapuṣpādibhūṣāḍhyaṃ dayitāśakta mānasamtridhā vā saptadhā vāpi daśadhā prajapenmanumśrīpādukāṃ pūjayāmi namo mantro gurupriyaḥguhyātimantrato mantrī samarpya stavamācaretvidyāvatārasaṃsiddhau svīkṛtānekavigraha !sarvājñānatamobheda bhānave cinmayāya teparatantrāya bhaktānāṃ bhavyānāṃ bhavadāyineprakāśināṃ prakāśāya jñānināṃ jñānarūpiṇemūlādhāre mūlavidyā - svarūpāṃ kulakuṇḍalīmsūryyakoṭi pratīkāśāṃ viṣatantutanīyamīmhaṃso - mantreṇa tasyāśca caitanyaṃ yojayettataḥtataśca saṃsmaret kaulān gurūnetān kuleśvari !kumārānandanāthaśca vaśiṣṭhānandanāthakaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00094 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: bodhānandastato nityaṃ kāraṇānandananditāḥtato vindusphuranmādhvī - dhārayā tān pratarpayettatprabhāpaṭalai rdevi ! pāṭalaṃ svaṃ vicintayetgopanīyaṃ mamaprītikṛte'vaśyaṃ sureśvarimahācīnākhyatantre ca trividhaṃ pūjanaṃ hi yatmānasaṃ yāntrikañcaiva śrotumicchāmi māmpratamakṛte nyāsajāle hi adhikāro na vidyatevarṇa vyāpakavinyāsau pīṭhanyāsa stataḥ paramugratārā devatoktā kūrccavījasudāhṛtamakhilavāgrūpiṇīmuktvā hṛdayāya namo vadetbrahmavāgrūpiṇīmuktvā śikhāyai vaṣaḍityapiviṣṇuvāgrūpiṇī netratrayāya vauṣaḍityapiṣaḍdīrghamāyayā caiva vījānāmeva coccaretādiḹvarṇaparyyantān hṛdaye vinyaset priyeṇādibhāntān makārādikṣāntān jaṅghādvaye priye !hṛtsaroje sudhāsindhuṃ madhye dvīpaṃ suvarṇajamtanmūle hemanirmmāṇaṃ dvāścatuṣṭaya bhūṣitamtatra yantraṃ pratiṣṭhāpya tatra pūjāṃ samācarethṛdipāṇyagramādāya jīvanyāsaṃ samācaretparipāṭī gurorjñeyā nyāsānāṃ racanaṃ priyesnāyācca vimale tīrthe puṣkare hṛdayāśritevinducyutasudhābhi stāṃ tarpayet prāṇavallabhe !udvarttanādikaṃ dattvā snāpayeddivyavāriṇālalāṭe caiva sindūraṃ alaktaṃ caraṇāmbujetataḥ so'hamiti dhyātvā pādyaṃ dadyāt padoḥ priye
source_edition: Muktabodha M00094 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: sugandhi - śvetalauhityaṃ javāṃ kṛṣṇāparājitāmsammukhe dhūpadīpau ca naivedyaṃ bhojayedathapunaśca kāraṇaṃ deyaṃ tato bharjjitaśālijamtato madyaṃ pradāyaiva nānā - temana - saṃyutam *ācamanaṃ tato dadyāttāmbūlaṃ vinivedayetstutvā natvā tattadaṅgadevatā [:] prāpayedathatataḥ sohamiti dhyāyedātmānaṃ tāriṇīmayamekāntanirmalaṃ cittaṃ hṛdambhojārccanāt priyekarttavya metadvidhivadgurupādaprasādataḥatha yāgagṛhaṃ gatvā puṣpāharaṇamācaretkūrcāstravahnilalanā tārādyaḥ puṣpakarṣaṇekamalāsanaṃ ṅentañca hṛnmanuścāsanārcaneādau śodhanamevoktaṃ nīlatantre tava priyetṛtīyaśodhane devi ! tryambakenaiva mantravitpratadviṣṇuriti mantreṇa svayambhvādiviśodhanamtato devi ! mahāyantraṃ kathayāmi tava priyecaturasraṃ caturdvāraṃ yantraṃ devi ! samālikhetpaścime kṣetrapālañca yoginīmuttare yajettanmūle maṇipīṭhañca nānāmaṇivibhūṣitamśivābhirvahumāṃsāsthi - modamānābhirantataḥhasauḥ sadāśivetyuktvā mahāpreta tataḥ paramlakṣmīḥ sarasvatī caiva ratiḥ prīti stathaiva caetāḥ pūjyāḥ patradeśe krameṇa prāṇaballabhehṛdaye dyautanaṃ tejaḥ parivārasamanvitamāṃ sohamiti mantreṇa jīvanyāsaṃ samācaret
source_edition: Muktabodha M00094 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: namaḥ svāhā svadhāñcaiva namo vauṣaṭ tathā kramātidaṃ dravyaṃ tataḥ procya devatābodhanaṃ tataḥmūlamantraṃ samuccārya ṅentaṃ nāma niyojayetidaṃ dravyaṃ samucārya parivārebhyo namo'ntataḥakṣobhyaṃ * maulideśe tu prāgādyaṣṭadaleṣu cavāyavyādīśaparyantaṃ gurupaṅktirvyavasthitānaivedyaṃ sādhakebhyaśca strībhyo dadyānna kutracitmānasaṃ yāntrikañcaiva nityaṃ nṛṇāmiti smṛtamvidheyaṃ pūjanaṃ devi ! na kuryādvā nijecchayāpātramekaṃ dvayaṃ vāpi trayaṃ vā pañca vā priyesambidānandayogena yaḥ kāraṇamado bhavettasmādbhuktvā siddhimūlaṃ sādhakaḥ kāraṇaṃ pivettanna cānanda - janakaṃ bauddhadeva - vaco yathātatpatnī sarvabhāvena sadā kaulikapūruṣaiḥtasmāt stotrairdhanairvākyai stoṣayet brahmadāyakamādau ṣaṅaṅgaṃ vinyasya gurordhyānaṃ tataḥparamseturūpaṃ tata stāraṃ japtvā japamathācaretśivo'haṃ tāriṇīrūpamātmānamiti cintayetiti te kathitaṃ devi ! rahasyaṃ tāriṇīmayamna deyaṃ paśave tasmāt śapatho me tvayi priye !tasyaivādyantamāhātmyaṃ śrotumicchāmi sāmpratamparameṣṭiguruścaiva catvāro guravaḥ smṛtāḥparāparaguruścāhaṃ tvameva parameṣṭikāgurorvinā mahāmokṣaṃ na kāśī na ca gaṅgayā (?)gurumantreṣṭadevīnāmekatvaṃ parikathyate
source_edition: Muktabodha M00094 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: saralyā'saralā vāpi niṣṭhurā vā priyoditāsadeṣṭadevobhāvena bhāvanīyā kulottamaiḥyatnenaiva vidhātavyamaśakye yatnavān bhavetbhojayennirvikalpena manasā vīravallabhaḥśodhayitvā nivedyaiva yo'śnīyāt sa ca bhairavaḥguru taddayitāputraputrī - sādhakayoṣitāṃavaśyaṃ tāriṇīmantre śaktipūjā vidhīyatesamānadevatāmantraṃ nijakrāntā japedyadiśarīrārdhaṃ smṛtā kāntā yasmāttadyatnavān bhavetmaithune varjanīyā yā stāsāṃ vidhi rihocyatesatīrthasya tu vīrasya sādhakasya tathā priye !maithunasya vidhānantu kathyate śṛṇu bhairavi !purato mūlamuccārya dharmādharmādikaṃ paṭhantasmāt śataṃ viṃśatiṃ vā japtvā tejastu pātayetiti taṃ kathitaṃ devi ! yathoktaṃ buddharūpiṇāsiddhipradaṃ samācārād gopanīyaṃ svayonivatpuraścaraṇahīnena mantreṇa na phalaṃ bhavetkuje vā śanivāre vā naramuṇḍaṃ samāharettatra naktaṃ daśaśataṃ prajapenmantrasiddhayeathavānyaprakāreṇa puraścaraṇamucyatedevavat pūjanaṃ kṛtvā japettāvad varānane !athavā mūrddhnipadme tu dhyātvā pūjāṃ vidhyāya caanenaiva vidhānena puraścaraṇamucyatecaturdaśīṃ samārabhya yāvadanyā caturdaśīetat sarvaṃ śmaśāne ca rātrau vīrairvidhīyate
source_edition: Muktabodha M00094 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: gopanīyaṃ prayatnena jananyā jāravat priye !puraścaraṇahīno'pi tathā mantraḥ prakīrtitaḥkartavyañca prayatnena puraścaraṇamuttamamgrāmyāraṇyajalasthānāṃ rudhiraṃ prītibarddhanamjanturaktena sampūrṇa - kalasāt parvatātmaje !lalāṭa - hasta - hṛdaya śirobhrūmadhya deśataḥbrāhmaṇo yadi vā kṣatro vaiśyaḥ śūdraśca eva vāśaktīnāṃ nādhikāro'sti svadeharudhirārpaṇepūrvoktamantrarājasya madhyavījatrayaṃ priye !ekaiva hi mahādevī nāmamātraṃ tridhā bhavetyathā pañcākṣarī tryarṇā tathā varṇacatuṣṭayamiti te kathitaṃ tattvaṃ durlabhaṃ mayakā priyegopanīyaṃ prayatnena yoniḥ paranare yathāugrāditrayamantrasya māhātmyaṃ varṇayāmyahamtārāmantravido mantrī kālīmantravida stathātārāmantraṃ vinā devi ! kālikāmantrameva catāriṇīhṛdayajñānī latāsādhana - tatparaḥnijakāntā - svarūpeṇa nijabandhusvarūpataḥpīḍādinā vidhīyeta devairbhaṅgo'tra sādhanesarvathā sarvayatnena sarvopāsyā ca tāriṇīiti te kathitaṃ tattvamanuṣṭheśca samāsataḥtārātantraṃ cīnatantraṃ kālītantraṃ guruditamdeyaṃ viṣyāya śāntāya sādhakāya mahātmaneanyadyannoktamatrāpi tatsarvaṃ guruvaktrataḥviruddhaṃ vedavāde'pi śrotavyaṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00094 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: cakāra nirjane deśe kṛcchreṇa tapasā vaśītathāpi sākṣād girijā na babhūva mahītalesarvaṃ tatkathayāmāsa svīyācārakramaṃ prabho !anyathā sudṛḍhaṃ śāpaṃ tadāgra (tvadagre) pradadāmi hipunastāṃ bhaja bhāvena yogamārgeṇa paṇḍitaḥsā devo paramā śaktiḥ sarvasaṅkaṭatāriṇīsthiravidyullatākoṭisadṛśī kālakāminīśuddhacīnācāraratā śakticakrapravartikābuddheśvarī buddhirūpā atharvavedaśākhinībhaja putra ! sthirānandaḥ kathaṃ śaptuṃ samudyataḥtasya (syā) darśanamevaṃ hi avaśyaṃ samavāpsyasijagāma udadhe stīre vaśī vedāntavit śuciḥādeśopi na babhūva tataḥ krodhaparo muniḥdvirācamya mahāśāpaḥ pradattaśca sudāruṇaḥājagāma mahāvidyā yogināmabhayapradāmama pūjāṃ na jānāsi matkulāgamacintanamprāpnoti mānuṣo devo mama dhyānamaduḥkhadammamaiva sādhanaṃ puṇyaṃ vedānāmapyagocaramtatra gatvā mahābhāvaṃ vilokya matpadāmbujametadvākyaṃ kathitvā sā vāyavyākāśagāminītato munivaraḥ śrutvā mahāvidyāsarasvatīmpunaḥ punaḥ praṇamyāsau vaśiṣṭhaḥ kṣitimaṇḍaleati dīnaṃ vaśiṣṭhaṃ māṃ sadāvyākulacetasamtavācāraṃ samālokya bhayāni santi me hṛdivedavahiṣkṛtaṃ karma sadā te cālaye prabho !
source_edition: Muktabodha M00094 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: muhurmuhuḥ prapivanti ramayanti varāṅganāmnigrahānugrahe śaktāḥ pūrṇāntaḥkaraṇodyatāḥityuvāca mahāyogī dṛṣṭvā vedavahiṣkṛtammanaḥ pravṛttireteṣāṃ kathaṃ bhavati pāvana (nī)yena vijñānamātrena rudrarūpī bhavet kṣaṇātpaśubhāvasthira cetāḥ paśusaṅgavivarjitaḥsadā yogābhyāsarato yogaśikṣādṛḍhabrataḥevaṃ krameṇa dharmātmā śīlaudāryaguṇānvitaḥevamabhyāsayogena vaśī yogī dine dinemadhyamaḥ svalpasaṃyukto bhūmityāgaḥ paro mataḥyogī bhūtvā kumbhakajño maunī bhakto divāniśambrahma - viṣṇu - śivā ete vāyavīgaticañcalāśaktau cittaṃ samādhāya cidrūpāyāṃ sthirāśayaḥśakticakraṃ satvacakraṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ navavigrahampratyakṣadevatāṃ śrīdāṃ caṇḍo devagā (?) nikṛntanīmkoṭisaudāminībhāsāṃ sarvatattvasvarūpiṇīmetanmārgaprasādena brahmā sraṣṭā svayaṃ mahānsarvasevyo mahāpūjyo yajurvedādhipo mahānsarveṣāmantakaḥ krodhī krodharājo mahābalaumāsenākarṣaṇaṃ siddhirdvimāse vākpatirbhavetevaṃ catuṣṭaye māsi bhaveddikpālagocaraḥetadācārasāraṃ hi sarveṣāmapyagocaramyogināṃ dṛḍhacittānaṃ bhaktānāmekamāsataḥpūrṇayogī bhavedvipraḥ ṣaṇmāsābhyāsayogataḥityuktvāṃ buddharūpī ca kārayāmāsa sādhanam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00094 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: mahāvidyāpadāmbhojanadarśanaṃ samavārupasimadirāsādhanaṃ kartuṃ jagāma kulamaṇḍapepunaḥ punaḥ sādhayitvā pūrṇayogī babhūva saḥtārāmārādhayāmāsa purā nīlācale muniḥgamayāmāsa varṣāṇāmayutaṃ dhyānatatparaḥnānugrahaṃ cakārāsau tārā saṃsāratāriṇīkopena jvalito vidyāṃ tatyāja piturantikebrahmā hi sa muniṃ prāha śṛṇu putra ! vaco mamaārādhaya śrīcaraṇamanudvignena cetasāsṛjāmi caturo vedān kalpayāmi sma līlayātattvajñānamayo viṣṇurbhuvanaṃ pālayatyasautārāmeva samārādhya saṃharatyakhilaṃ jatatkathaṃ dattā durārādhyā vidyā mahyamiyaṃ tvayānīlācale nivasatā haviṣyaṃ bhuñjatā mayātato gaṇḍūṣamātrantu kāle kāle pivan jalamtathāpi yadi naivābhūttāriṇyāḥ karuṇā mayiparaṃ samādhimāsādya nirāhāro dṛḍhavrataḥativāhitavān varṣaṃ sahasrāṣṭakamuttamamkāmākhyāyonimāśriya samārādhitavān prabho !ata styajāmi duḥsādhyāṃ vidyāmetāṃ suduḥkhitaḥuvāca śāntayan putraṃ vaśiṣṭhaṃ munīnāṃ varamtatrasthito mahādevī mārādhaya dṛḍhavrataḥacirādeva te siddhirbhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥimāṃ tyaktvā punarvidyāṃ anyāṃ kāṃ tvaṃ grahauṣyasipunarjagāma kāmākhyā - yonimaṇḍalasannidhim
source_edition: Muktabodha M00094 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ārādhayan mahāmāyāṃ vaśiṣṭho'pi jitendriyaḥjagmustārā - mahādevī - pādāmbhojā - nuvartiṇaḥtadā roṣeṇa mahatā jajvāla sa munīśvaraḥetasminneva kāle tu ruṣṭamālokya taṃ munimhāhākāro mahānāsīddevi ! deveṣu sarvataḥvaśiṣṭha stāṃ samālokya śaśapātovadāruṇamcīnācāraṃ vinā naiva prasīdāmi kadācanaroṣeṇa dāruṇamanāḥ kathaṃ mā manuśaptavāneka eva vijānāti nānyaḥ kaścana tatvataḥviruddhācāraśīlena mama tattvamajānatātenopadiṣṭācāreṇa māmārādhaya suvrata !jagāmācāravijñānavāñchayā buddharūpiṇamdadarśa himavatpārśve sādhakeśvarasevitemadirāmodacittena vilāsollasitena cabhayalajjāvihīnena devyā dhyānapareṇa camadirāpānasañjāta - mandamandavilocanavismayena samāviṣṭaḥ smaran saṃsāratāriṇīmvedavādaviruddhoyamācāro'sammato mamaākāśavāṇī prāhāśu maivaṃ cintaya suvrata !etadviruddhabhāvasya mate nāsau prasīdatietena cīnācāreṇa tadā tāṃ bhaja suvrata !vaśiṣṭho daṇḍavadbhūmau papātātīvaharṣitaḥjagāma viṣṇoḥ śaraṇaṃ buddharūpasya pārvati !prāha buddhaḥ prasannātmā kimarthaṃ tvamihāgataḥyaduktaṃ tāriṇīdevyā nijārādhanakarmaṇi
source_edition: Muktabodha M00094 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: vaśiṣṭhaṃ prāhamajñānaṃ cīnācārādhikāraṇān (ṇam)tava bhaktivaśenāsmi prakāśyamiha tatparaḥyasyānuṣṭhānamātreṇa bhavābdhau na nimajjasitattvajñānamayaṃ sākṣādvimuktiphaladāyakampūjanaṃ mānasaṃ divyaṃ mānasaṃ tarpaṇādikamna viśeṣo divārātrau na sandhyāyāṃ mahāniśiśuddhiṃ na cācarettatra nirvikalpaṃ manaścaretsarvadā pūjayeddevīmasnātaḥ kṛtabhojanaḥstrīdveṣo naiva kartavyo viśeṣāt pūjanaṃ striyāṃ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00094 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]
